summary: Recent updates to Media Source Extensions (MSE) in Firefox focus on improving the logging and testing processes related to video playback. One notable change includes implementing **MOZ_LOG_FMT**, which enhances the way developers can track and troubleshoot media operations. Additionally, the introduction of automated tests, specifically a mochitest for H.264 video segments that contain oversized SPS (Sequence Parameter Set) picture widths, ensures that the browser can reliably handle various media formats. These enhancements are essential for maintaining robust video streaming experiences and ensuring compatibility with diverse video content.
